sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption reflected on the integrity system after six years in office.
sentences.support:
Over six years of operation I have concluded that South Australia does not 
have a public administration that is systemically corrupt.

sentences.text: The Commissioner discussed maladministration, staff conduct, conflicts of interest, recruitment and barriers to reporting wrongdoing.
sentences.support:
Conflicts of interest continue to present in matters relating to procurement, 
administrative decision making and recruitment.

sentences.text: The Commissioner concluded that maladministration and poor conduct created conditions for individual corruption even though public administration was not systemically corrupt.
sentences.support:
Over six years of operation I have concluded that South Australia does not 
have a public administration that is systemically corrupt.

sentences.text: The Commissioner urged authorities to strengthen workforce and records oversight, review conflict policies and verify essential recruitment qualifications.
sentences.support:
Essential qualifications for a role must always be verified as 
should any relevant experience or knowledge a candidate professes to have.

findings.quote:
Public administration must ensure it is managing its workforce and records 
appropriately through utilising proper systems and processes and applying 
appropriate oversight.

notes: No separate executive summary or equivalent synopsis is provided. Advice is unnumbered; the 18 recommendations mentioned in this report refer to an earlier report, so are not counted as recommendations of this report.
